title: A small shared step for NF1 families: proposal to Children's Tumor Foundation

sentences.text: At RASopathies Network, we support NF1 families; the atlas also connects Children's Tumor Foundation (CTF) to this community, marking that connection as inferred.
NF1 and LZTR1-related disorders share a problem with the body's controls on RAS cell signals, giving us a reason to explore collaboration—not proof that the same approaches will work.

sections.heading: What already exists that we could share

sentences.text: CTF's NF Registry includes NF1, while NF1 inclusion in our developing contact registry is inferred by the atlas and needs confirmation.

Other NF1 resources include the Natural History Study of Patients With Neurofibromatosis Type I, Neurofibromatosis Type 1 Patient Registry, Neurofibromatosis (NF) Registry Portal and RASopathy Biorepository.
We could begin by sharing information about these resources rather than assuming access to their data.

sections.heading: What must be checked before we join forces

sentences.text: Please help confirm whether tibial pseudarthrosis and lower limb dysmetria occur in LZTR1-related disorders, and check pilocytic astrocytoma across LZTR1, CBL and PTPN11 comparisons rather than treating missing records as evidence of absence.
We should also check the first two features across CBL and PTPN11 comparisons.
PTPN11 needs particular care: its loss-of-function evidence concerns metachondromatosis, whereas the cited Noonan syndrome evidence describes increased protein activity.
Please also review whether published evidence supports any pathway-targeted treatment for learning and attention problems, for discussion with a neurologist—not as treatment advice.
Send CTF one focused inquiry asking whether PATRAS, the PATient-based Registry for phenotyping and therapy evaluation in RASopathies (EURAS), could include NF1.
Its LZTR1 connection is inferred by the atlas, so eligibility remains to be confirmed.
Is there any pathway-targeted treatment for learning and attention problems in NF1 or other RASopathies?
Could we check the NF Clinical Trials Consortium and CTF pipeline for learning and attention outcomes in ongoing trials?
Dear Children's Tumor Foundation team,
We would welcome a small collaboration for NF1 families.
Could you help establish whether PATRAS could include NF1?
We propose starting with an eligibility inquiry this month.
Please help us identify what needs checking before going further.
Thank you for considering this request.
[Your name], on behalf of RASopathies Network (RASopathiesNet USA / UK)
